unscored: UNSCORED: no committed criterion; provisional simulated learner
provisional: simulated learner and scorer are PROVISIONAL builder placeholders (learner.ts, score.ts); personalization-eval to replace or own them; smoke test, not evidence
simulatedOnly: simulated personas only; no real learner data is read

columns.recall: simulated first-revisit recall over all lessons completed (mean over episodes)
columns.prereqFirst: share of cards shown before an in-pilot prerequisite
columns.gain: concepts known at end minus start (ground truth; extra, not in OBJECTIVE)
columns.movedShare: share of cards moved off the default order
columns.circular: circular: diagnostic only: EDP-style, graded by the model's own detect() and addr(), not by the learner; never a pass score, always beside recall
columns.circular.needCoverageRate: Σ min(need, addr[served card, need]) / Σ need over every served new card, needs and addr from the evidence when the card is served (EDP resolved / initial mass), pooled over episodes
columns.circular.domainDiversity: Shannon entropy of served new cards' domains / log2(pilot domains), 0..1, mean over episodes (EDP widget-mix entropy)
columns.circular.distinctDomainsServed: distinct domains among served new cards, mean over episodes
